name: Zarephath
overview: The Scripture passage in 1 Kings 17:8-13 reveals God's directive to the prophet Elijah to go to Zarephath, a town belonging to Zidon, where a widow has been appointed by the Lord to provide for him. Despite her dire circumstances, with only a handful of meal and a little oil left, the widow obeys Elijah's request to make him a cake first, trusting in God's provision. This narrative highlights God's miraculous provision and faithfulness, demonstrated through Elijah's ministry in Zarephath, where two miracles were performed, underscoring the Lord's sovereignty and care even in times of scarcity.
